messages:
Sahil: Heads up — noticed a sharp perf regression on mixtral-7b in canary after the smart-kernel routing change. p50 latency up ~40% on short prompts; token throughput drops for bursty traffic.
Kevin: repro script / perf job id?
Sahil: ran nightly perf job 2026-03-15T03:45Z, job id perf-2330-canary. Quick grep from the profiler: 
```
Flame: runtime::kernel_select -> 62%
Flame: kv_cache::evict -> 18% (eviction rate 0.48)
Flame: batching::enqueue -> 14%
KERNEL: patch_rope_scaled_matmul (hot)
```
Sahil: eviction rate jumped after we enabled continuous batching + smarter kernel pick that prefers the new quant path. Looks like RoPE scaling cases are mis-routing to a kernel variant that thrashes KV layout.
Anna: any differences in model metadata? we recently tightened HF config parsing defaults. If safetensors metadata misses rotary/heads info we fallback to inferred dims — that can mutate layout.
Maria: CI-bot showed a conversion warning for mixtral7b-v2 on 03/14: "missing 'rotary_emb' -> assumed scale=1.0". Might be related.
CI-bot: [warning] conversion/scripts/convert_hf.py: mixtral7b-v2.safetensors missing key 'rotary_emb' metadata, applying heuristic.
Kevin: can you paste the conversion snippet that logs the fallback?
Sahil: here's the exact converter output: 
```
INFO: parsing safetensors header
WARN: metadata.rotary_emb not found
INFO: inferred num_heads=32, head_dim=128 from weight shapes
WARN: applied rope_scale=1.0 (heuristic)
```
Sahil: runtime then picked kernel variant `rotary_scaled_matmul_v2_quant` because rotor_scale != 1.0 check failed earlier in the new selector logic. So we create a mismatch between assumed layout and actual kv packing.
Anna: ah — two independent defaults tripping each other. converter assumed 1.0 but runtime path expects explicit rope_scaling field to enable the non-quant kernel. If kernel selector prefers quant path when rope_scale missing, we'll hit a mismatched code path.
Maria: short mitigation: pin kernel selection for model-id mixtral7b-v2 to legacy dense kernel until we fix parsing+selector. I can open a quick rollback PR for canary.
Kevin: good. Also lower continuous-batching max_batch_size for that route to limit KV churn as a stopgap.
Sahil: I pushed a local override on canary: 
```
routes["mixtral7b-v2"].kernel_hint = "legacy_dense"
runtime.batching.continuous_max = 8
```
Sahil: immediate p50 dropped back ~18% but eviction still higher than baseline. Full fix needs: 1) tighten safetensors metadata check in converter and fail noisily, 2) change kernel selector to treat missing rope metadata as explicit default (not invert semantics), 3) add unit test that simulates head_dim mismatch.
Anna: I'll add a strict validation step to convert_hf.py and make it return non-zero if rotary metadata absent unless --allow-heuristic provided. That will catch new uploads.
Maria: I'll draft the kernel selector patch to treat missing rope_scaling as 1.0 but not switch to quant-kernel unless an explicit quant flag is present.
Kevin: also add a perf regression test: synthetic seq lengths 8/32/256 with mixtral7b-v2, collect kv eviction metric and kernel choice histogram. PR should block merges if eviction delta > 0.2.
Sahil: attaching quick probe commands I ran: 
```
# run synthetic workload
bin/run_perf --model mixtral7b-v2 --seq 32 --batch 6 --warm 20 --iter 200 --profile out.pb
python tools/pprof_summary.py out.pb | head -n 30
```
Ops-bot: created issue INFR-1298 "mixtral7b-v2 kernel routing -> kv eviction thrash" and linked perf job perf-2330-canary.
Maria: assigning INFR-1298 to Anna + Kevin. I'll include the canary override and rollback PR in the issue.
Sahil: FYI: found a small additional symptom — when rope_scale is NaN in parsed HF configs (bad float string), selector treated it as truthy and chose scaled kernel. Need to sanitize parsing.
Anna: noted. validation fix will cast and verify finiteness.
Kevin: plan for next 24h: patch converter validation (Anna), patch kernel selector (Maria), add perf regression CI job (Kevin), rollback canary for mixtral7b-v2 if perf doesn't stabilize (Maria).
Sahil: thanks, will rerun perf after each change and update INFR-1298. :thumbsup:
Maria: :shipit:
